description: Legacy PowerShell cmdlet to query classic Windows Event Logs. Superseded by Get-WinEvent for modern systems but still useful for quick queries.
prerequisites: Read access to event logs (Admin for Security log)
Best used on pre-Vista systems or small logs

flags.purpose: Retrieve events from a specific log with optional filtering.
flags.outputs: Event objects with TimeGenerated, EntryType, Source, Message.
flags.security_use_case: Identify failed authentication attempts indicating brute force.
flags.threat_detected: Repeated failed logons from same source (credential stuffing/brute force).
flags.risk_if_misused: Performance issues on large logs; prefer Get-WinEvent.
flags.safe_followup: Correlate source IP; apply firewall or account lockout policy.

flags.purpose: Filter events by Event ID (InstanceId). Note: Get-EventLog accepts only a single InstanceId value. For multiple IDs, use Get-WinEvent with FilterHashtable.
flags.security_use_case: Track logons and privilege assignments for compromise investigation.
flags.threat_detected: Successful logon followed by special privilege use (privilege escalation).
flags.note: For multiple EventIDs, use: Get-WinEvent -LogName Security -FilterHashtable @{ID=4624,4625,4672}
flags.risk_if_misused: Exact ID match only; may miss related events. Multiple IDs require Get-WinEvent.

flags.purpose: Limit output to most recent events by type.
flags.security_use_case: Rapid diagnostics for crashes, service failures, suspicious reboots.
flags.threat_detected: System instability due to exploitation or tampering.

flags.security_use_case: Investigate incidents within last N days.
flags.threat_detected: Recent failed logons, account abuse, privilege misuse.

flags.purpose: Filter events associated with a specific username.
flags.threat_detected: Off-hours admin logons, unusual privilege usage.
flags.risk_if_misused: String match may be inaccurate for domain accounts.

flags.threat_detected: Malicious scripts, lateral movement via PowerShell.
flags.risk_if_misused: Slow on large logs; limited wildcard support.

flags.purpose: List all event logs and record counts.
flags.security_use_case: Discover unusual or custom logs with attacker traces.
flags.threat_detected: Log manipulation or abnormal log growth/shrinkage.

powerful_combinations.why_powerful: Builds 24-hour compromise timeline across logon, privilege, and process events using Get-WinEvent for multiple EventIDs.

powerful_combinations.command: Get-EventLog -LogName Application -EntryType Error -Newest 200 | Group-Object Source | Sort-Object Count -Descending
powerful_combinations.why_powerful: Identifies noisy applications possibly under attack or failing due to exploitation.
Tracks all account lifecycle changes for insider threat detection using Get-WinEvent for multiple IDs.
